checks.name: Behavior and coverage
checks.command:
python -m coverage run --branch --source=framework/src/specflow -m unittest discover -v -s framework/tests -p 'test_*.py'
python -m coverage json -o coverage.json
python -m coverage report --fail-under=80
python - <<'PY'
import json
value = json.load(open('coverage.json'))

checks.name: Clean installation and consumer smoke
checks.command:
python - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess, sys, venv, json, os
venv.create('.smoke', with_pip=True)
scripts = pathlib.Path('.smoke') / ('Scripts' if os.name == 'nt' else 'bin')
python = scripts / ('python.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'python')
exe = scripts / ('specflow.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'specflow')
wheel, = pathlib.Path('release-dist').glob('*.whl')
subprocess.run([str(python), '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--no-index', '--no-deps', str(wheel)], check=True)
def run(*args, expected=0):
    r = subprocess.run([str(exe), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == expected, (r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r.stdout
assert run('--version').strip() == '0.1.0'
run('--help')
run('init', '.consumer', '--integration', 'copilot', '--integration', 'codex', '--json')
run('--project', '.consumer', 'doctor', '--json')
change = json.loads(run('--project', '.consumer', 'nova-change', 'Smoke release', '--json'))['changeId']
assert json.loads(run('--project', '.consumer', 'contexto', '--change', change, '--json'))['observedState'] == 'RASCUNHO'
run('--project', '.consumer', 'implementar', '--change', change, '--json', expected=1)
assert not pathlib.Path('.consumer/apps').exists()
PY
